descriptions.zh: 规划、研究、起草、改写、自然化、适配和审核编辑内容：可从一句目标直接完成社媒成稿，也支持文章、博客、newsletter、教程、案例、观点稿和资料型改写，并保留来源边界与作者声音。
descriptions.en: Plan, research, draft, revise, humanize, adapt, and audit social and long-form editorial content with channel-aware structure, evidence boundaries, voice preservation, and publication-readiness gates.

applicable_domain: individual social posts, long-form articles, blogs, newsletters, explainers, tutorials, case studies, opinion pieces, and research-backed reports
outlining, source-grounded drafting, structural revision, voice-preserving humanization, citation review, and pre-publish content audit
negative_examples: operate a publishing platform, browser CMS, or social media account
create a social calendar, operate a social account, or execute a multi-post campaign
provide final professional legal, medical, or financial advice
certify human authorship or guarantee bypass of AI-detection systems
prerequisites: a topic, content request, source pack, outline, or draft is available
current or externally checkable claims can be verified when strict publication readiness is requested
